No empirical tests with other RL algorithms (e.g., PPO, TD3, DDPG) or theoretical justification are provided to support this broad generalization.

The paper makes the broad claim that the reset strategy "can be integrated with any RL-based black-box optimization approach without modifying the underlying algorithm" and is a "plug-and-play enhancement," but the experiments only instantiate "update model following SAC" (Alg. 1) and Sec. 2.3 specifically motivates choosing SAC; no experiments or theory are given for other RL algorithms.

The paper broadly claims in the abstract that its reset strategy is a "plug-and-play enhancement for any RL-based optimization approach," but the experimental evaluation in Section 5 exclusively tests a Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) algorithm without empirical evidence for other RL methods.
